newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee market shows upward price trend.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee market shows upward price trend.

text.p: Bremen coffee markets attracted brisk buying interest, with prices following a clear trend higher, traders said on Friday.
Brazil business was guided by second hand opportunities as origin offers rose. Colombia prices also remained at a high level throughout the week.
Central Americans did well, despite the increased differentials, while Kenya prices reached another peak.
Robustas were traded on forward terms with shipments ranging from March/Feb to June/July, and prices remained attractive.
